newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded steady on refinery fire.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded steady on refinery fire.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials were steady in Chicago following reports of a fire that trimmed crude runs at a key regional refinery, traders said on Tuesday.
Shell Oil Co said runs were trimmed "minimally" and a 20,000 barrel per day alkylation unit was idled but undamaged by a fire in a gas plant at its 268,000 barrel per day Woods River, Ill., refinery.
A Shell spokesperson said the alkylation unit should be back on line Wednesday and crews were assessing damage to the gas plant.
